candidates: When a refactoring removes a function or piece of code that was the sole consumer of a React hook (e.g., `useTheme` from `storybook/theming`), also remove the hook's import statement and any resulting unused variable declarations; leaving either behind creates dead code that misleads future readers about what the component actually needs.

When migrating inline style objects to CSS class-based styling (e.g., replacing a `getStyle` prop with `styled`-component class names), explicitly account for every CSS property in the original style objects: either port each property to the new stylesheet rules or leave a brief comment confirming it is intentionally omitted. Silently dropping properties makes it ambiguous whether the omission was deliberate or an oversight.
